question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides that "the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21A**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **21A Article:** The State shall **provide free and compulsory education** to all children of the **age of 6-14 years** in such manner as the State may, by law,
